coverage_state: All 96 pinned donor methods mapped; semantic test review and final updated ERP source adoption are outstanding. Mapping does not claim final migration acceptance.
pending_external_source: expanded-source acceptance and final reviewed handoff
adaptation_limits: Stored-read cases currently assert unchanged rows/no source opens but do not install the donor SQL authorizer against donor tables; Poise normalized store owns reads.
Malformed target-policy shapes are explicit; donor standalone invalid-JSON policy file is represented by Poise whole-policy parsing rather than a second standalone session-history file.
Original fixed-period empirical totals are reported donor evidence, not independently reproduced Poise totals. Literal local-midnight, duplicate and integer tests supply independent product oracles.

methods.limitation: Mapping is traceability, not proof of exhaustive assertions or current GREEN. ERP CLI/ledger calls are adapted to existing Poise owners; no second ledger is introduced.
